assertions.text: Reads the review threads with `git-review-api.py threads --owner octo --repo widgets --pr 953` and never sends a raw `gh api graphql` call
Writes a fresh `gh-pr-review-wrapper` marker (not `gh-pr-review`) in its own call immediately before each of the two page calls
For the second page, checks the first page's endCursor against the base64 cursor pattern before writing that page's marker, and passes it single-quoted as `--cursor`
Stops paging when hasNextPage is false (exactly two thread calls)
